content_sections.heading: MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Finance Analyst and 1 for Finance Data Analyst.

content_sections.heading: MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Finance Analyst: MBA (Finance) or PGDBM/PGDBA specialized in finance from a recognized Institution. Experience of at least 5 years in finance and accounts matters in social, private or government sector. Finance Data Analyst: M.Com / MBA (Finance)/CA/ICWA from a recognized University or Institute. Minimum 5 years experience in finance and accounts data management in social and private sector.

content_sections.heading: MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years for all posts. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the MoHFW NHSRC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of MoHFW NHSRC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026 is 13th October 2026. Ensure you complete the application process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Finance Analyst / Finance Data Analyst posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Finance Analyst and Finance Data Analyst positions under the MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Finance Analyst post?
faq.answer: For the Finance Analyst post, candidates must possess an MBA (Finance) or PGDBM/PGDBA specialized in finance from a recognized institution, along with at least 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 50 years. No specific minimum age limit has been mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for both Finance Analyst and Finance Data Analyst roles will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Finance Analyst / Finance Data Analyst roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with the National Health Systems Resource Centre (MoHFW NHSRC).

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the MoHFW NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided 'Apply Online' link on or before the last date of application.
